policy.candidate_identity: Research source name + provenance only. Not semantic proof. No T5 or Core residency.
policy.coordinates: Coordinates are PROVISIONAL research name reservations, may be revised after source-grade semantic proof; no runtime/codec effects.
policy.lower_domains: No new D10 code is assigned to exact names already present in ratified D1–D9; behavioral distinctions require a separate proof.
policy.core_admission: Only independent language-visible laws, not aliases/data/constants/host IO, can become canonically selected.
policy.capacity: D10 has 1024 codes. Current canonical 715; reservations 96 do not change canonical occupancy.
